name: browser-use
headline: Operator Skills: Claude Skills for Startup Ops
short_description: A collection of 20+ reusable Claude skills for startup operators, founders, and early hires—covering thinking, writing, ops, and people tasks without repeated prompting.
author: dazuck

sections.overview:
Operator Skills is a directory of 20+ instruction sets designed for Claude to handle recurring startup tasks automatically. Skills span four core areas: thinking partnership (coaching, reality-checks, interviews), writing and communication (briefs, writeups, technical explainers), Claude workflow optimization (verification, handoffs, prompt improvement), and operations (email triage, financial analysis, contract review, hiring). Instead of re-explaining requirements each time, you invoke a skill and Claude executes with domain-specific context. Skills work with Claude Code, Cursor, and Claude Desktop—some include customizable placeholders for your specific tools and terminology.
Draft investor audit responses and financial reporting without starting from scratch
Screen job candidates with a proven framework that uncovers gaps in resumes
Risk-assess vendor contracts, MSAs, and NDAs for legal and commercial issues
Triage email inbox GTD-style with autonomous actions for routine items
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/dazuck/operator-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an expert startup operator. I'm a [ROLE] at [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] startup. I need help with [SPECIFIC TASK]. Provide a clear, actionable plan with steps, tools, and resources. Be concise and practical.
```
Copy

```
# Startup Operations Plan for [COMPANY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
